FAQ.title: FAQs
FAQ.description: Everything food entrepreneurs ask before working with us. Don't see your question? Just ask on the form above.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a grocery delivery app?
faqs.answer: Our standard grocery app package launches in 2–4 weeks. Custom enterprise builds with AI recommendations and B2B ordering may take 6–8 weeks. We give you a precise timeline after the free consultation.

faqs.question: What is the cost of grocery delivery app development in India?
faqs.answer:
Pricing depends on your app type and features.

Basic Single-Store Apps: Start at ₹2.5 Lakhs.

Multi-Vendor Platforms: Range from ₹5–15 Lakhs.

We provide a fixed-price quote in INR with no hidden charges.

faqs.question: Do I get 100% source code ownership?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You own every line of code, the database, and all intellectual property. No licensing fees. You can work with any development team after delivery. Code is delivered via GitHub or Bitbucket.

faqs.question: Which payment gateways are supported for grocery apps?
faqs.answer: We pre-integrate Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree, PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay, UPI, all major credit/debit cards, Net Banking, Wallets, and Cash on Delivery — all PCI-DSS compliant out of the box.

faqs.question: Can I add scheduled delivery slots or subscriptions?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support scheduled delivery slots, recurring order subscriptions (daily/weekly/monthly), pause & skip functionality, and auto-renewal billing — all natively built into the platform.

faqs.question: Do you build apps for quick commerce / 10-minute delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialize in quick commerce apps similar to Blinkit and Zepto — dark store management, zone-based driver dispatch, inventory reservation, and real-time order status targeting 10–30 minute delivery.

faqs.question: Do you sign an NDA before discussing my project?
faqs.answer: Yes, always. We sign a mutual NDA before any project discussion. Your idea stays 100% protected. Consultations are completely confidential with no obligation to proceed.

faqs.question: Do you support regional languages like Hindi, Tamil, or Telugu?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our apps support 10+ Indian regional languages — Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Malayalam, and Odia — with full RTL support for Arabic too.
